rule: tools/original/course-underlay.mjs: the light build's ground (tools/lite/static/ground.mjs buildGround) under 웹원본's own where it draws nothing from 0.25 m under the ground to 0.3 m over it (in a course's band: its road and runoff and 6 m beyond) or from 3 m under to 1.5 m over (within 2 m of the reachable cells), never over 웹원본's own water or lower ground (down to 3 m under the ground; 1.1 m or more past a road's edge) where physics agrees in explore's cell over it (dry and reachable: its floor from 0.05 m over that ground to 0.3 m under it; else its floor or water at most 0.3 m over it), nor over 웹원본's own water at any depth where explore has water at its level (0.3 m under it at most) or higher (a road's edge too); where the light build's ground is unknown and 웹원본 draws nothing at all over a quarter (no road's edge near), physics' floor (the mean of explore's dry floors round each corner, eased across explore's own holes), and one cell round each where 웹원본 has a surface near the ground; 0.03 m under the lowest near surface or water round each corner; a skirt where it ends: down to 웹원본's surface beyond, 0.1 m under it, where that is 4 m down at most, or 1.2 m where it is nearer, deeper or there is none; none where 웹원본's own steep face stands from 1.4 m inside the edge to 0.3 m beyond it over the skirt's whole length and depth

layout.order: Int16 i[cells], Int16 j[cells] (source x = i * cell, y = j * cell), Uint16 height[vertices] (z = base + height * quantum; the cells' corners in order of j, then i), Uint8 flags[cells] (bit 0: materials[1]; bits 1-4: a skirt on the edge at -x, +x, -y, +y), then with layout.depth Uint8 depth[cells] (the depth of each cell skirts in those steps; 0: skirt)
